scriptLines: admission_date = coalesce(   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy MM dd'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),   toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy') ),

discharge_date = iif(   isNull(discharge_date) || trim(discharge_date) == '' || upper(trim(discharge_date)) == 'NULL',   toDate(null()),   coalesce(     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy MM dd'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy')   ) ),

department = case(   isNull(department) || trim(department) == '' || upper(trim(department)) == 'NULL', 'No registrado',   startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'oncol'), 'Oncology',   startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'cardio'), 'Cardiology',   startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'emerg') || lower(trim(department)) == 'er', 'Emergency',   startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'pediat') || startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'paediat') || lower(trim(department)) == 'peds', 'Pediatrics',   startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'generalsurg') || startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'gensurg'), 'General Surgery',   startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'neuro') || startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'nuerol'), 'Neurology',   startsWith(regexReplace(lower(trim(department)), '[^a-z]', ''), 'ortho'), 'Orthopedics',   trim(department) )) ~> derivedColumn
